title: Make the next safe action obvious
summary: Applies behavioral UX principles to reduce friction without dark patterns: smarter defaults, visible workflow progress, contextual notification permission, protected drafts and clearer before-versus-after review.
changes: Changes now opens on the step that actually needs attention for each selected night and shows genuine progress toward a ready or shared plan, while the standard automatic six-nurse plan stays quiet.

Notification permission is no longer requested just after sign-in. Night Roster first lets the user reach Team Chat, then offers optional alerts with benefit-first privacy wording and keeps the operating-system permission behind an explicit tap.

Unfinished local Changes selections now warn before a browser reload and block a PWA update from discarding them, while confirmation labels Rostered versus This night so exceptional changes are easier to compare before sharing.
